name: Sparky's: After Dark
storyline: You're hired as the night-time security guard in Sparky's Bash Jam Emporium. Throughout the week, the animatronics Sparky (based on the original Sparky the Dog hoax), Worgen (a reimagining of the twisted wolf as an animatronic), Mathew, and Mendo (debuting in a classic FNaF-style horror game, originally from FNaF world), will attempt to hunt down and kill the player. The restaurant is closing by week's end, where the animatronics will then be disposed of.
summary:
Sparky's, a failing family restaurant, has hired YOU as their newest night security guard to protect the office equipment before the business' closure by week's end.

Ward off Sparky, Worgen, Mathew, and Mendo as they do everything in their power to... you know the drill.

Set in the world based on Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's', see if you have what it takes to survive 5 nights. And maybe a 6th. ...and maybe one more?
